reranked.text:
## How to Apply
- Enter personal details.
- Enter professional details.
- Complete Video KYC.
- Open the account.
## What is BSBDA?
BSBDA stands for Basic Savings Bank Deposit Account, introduced by the RBI to promote financial inclusion and make banking accessible to economically weaker sections of society.
## Is Minimum Balance Required?
No, there is no minimum balance requirement.
## Can a Customer Open More Than One BSBDA?
No, an individual cannot hold more than one BSBDA account.
## Can a Customer Have Both BSBDA and Other Savings Accounts?
Yes, AU Bank states that BSBDA account holders are eligible to open another savings account in the same bank.
## Ideal Customer Profile
Suitable for:
- First-time banking customers.
- Customers seeking a zero-balance savings account.
- Individuals from economically weaker sections.
- Customers looking for basic banking services with no maintenance charges.

reranked.text:
## Eligibility
To apply for an AU Personal Loan:
- Must be an Indian resident.
- Minimum age: 21 years at application.
- Maximum age at loan maturity: 65 years.
- Loan tenure: 12 months to 5 years.
- Loan amount eligibility up to Rs 15,00,000.
## Application Process
- Visit the AU 0101 App or AU Bank website.
- Click Apply Now.
- Enter personal and financial details.
- Verify through OTP.
- Upload required documents.
- Receive instant approval (subject to eligibility).
- Check for any pre-approved offers available.
Alternatively, customers can visit an AU branch for assisted application processing.
## Processing Fee
- Up to 4% of approved loan amount
- Minimum Rs 2,000
- Concessions available for AU Royale/IVY customers.
## Documentation Charges
- Nil.
## Administration Charges
- Nil.
## Stamp Duty
- Applicable as per respective State Stamp Act.
## Overdue Interest
- 3% per month on outstanding overdue amount.
## Foreclosure / Prepayment Charges
- Not allowed before 6 months.
- Between 6–12 months: 5% of outstanding balance.
- After 12 months: 3% of outstanding balance.

BSBDA stands for Basic Savings Bank Deposit Account, introduced by the RBI to promote financial inclusion and make banking accessible to economically weaker sections of society.

No, an individual cannot hold more than one BSBDA account.

- Travel frequently and value lounge access.
- Require family banking benefits.
- Need dedicated relationship management and priority service.
